_comment: Domain sample pool for the realistic scenario: what real notes in this app look like, written once and committed, each title paired with a body that belongs to it. {slots} are filled by faker (people, companies, places, dates, numbers), the same value everywhere in one note; the text around them is domain text faker cannot write convincingly. Replace with your real domain's pool when the notes exemplar goes.

notes.title: Call with {person} ({company})
notes.body: {firstName} wants a revised quote by {weekday}. They are comparing us with two other vendors; price matters less than setup time.

- workload feels heavy since the {month} release
